s: Habdala sheoseh sheliach tzibbur ubo h' seipim: nohagim lomar "vihi noam" lepi shehu mizmor shel beraka, shebbo berak mosheh et yisrael beshaa shessiyyemu meleket hammishkan. Venohagim likpol pasuq "orek yamim vego'", sheal yede kak nishlam hashshem hayyotze mimmennu. Venohagin lomar seder qedushsha. Umatchilin "veatta qadosh" velo "uba letziyyon goel", lepi sheen geulla ballayla. Vekol zeh haarikut shemmaarikin achar tepillat arbit bemotzae shabbat, hu kede sheyyishtahu yisrael behashlamat sidrehem, kede lehaarik lareshaim millachazor legehinnom, ki mamtinim lahem ad sheyyashlimu kenesiyya acharona shebbeyisrael et sidrehem:
Yesh nohagim mittaam hayyadua lahem lomar meummad pasuq "vihi noam":

Im chal yom tob o yom hakkippurim beachad yeme hammaaseh beshabua habba, apillu chal beereb shabbat habba — en nohagim lomar "vihi noam", shekkevan sheomerim "umaaseh yadenu konena" b' peamim — tzarik sheyyihyu kol hashsheshet yamim reuyim limlaka. Abal im chal beshabbat omerim oto. Ubizman sheen omerim oto — en nohagim lomar gam "veatta qadosh" vekol seder qedushsha, lepi she"vihi noam" shayyak limleket hammishkan, veal yede kak shorta shekina beyisrael, vezehu "veatta qadosh yosheb tehillot yisrael", al ken hen nismakin zeh lezeh leolam. Abal "veyitten leka" nohagim lomar bekol inyan:

Nohagim shehashsheliach tzibbur mabdil bebet hakkeneset al hayyayin, kede lehotzi mi sheen lo yayin bebeto lehabdil alayv. (Veyishteh mehakkos beatzmo im nitkavven latzet yede chobato behabdala zo, o yashqeh mimmennu leacher shennitkavven latzet yede chobato. Abal im mashqeh mimmennu letinoqot — en shum adam yakol latzet yede chobato behabdala zo, kevan shello shata mehakkos adam sheyyotze yede chobato behabdala zo):

Nahagu lomar ulehazkir eliyyahu hannabi bemotzae shabbat achar habdala, lehitpallel sheyyabo vibasserenu haggeulla, sheen eliyyahu ba beereb shabbat shello lebattel yisrael meisqe tzorke hashshabbat, vegam beshabbat eno ba im yesh issur techumin lemala mi' tepachim, veal ken anu mitpalelim: kevan sheabar hashshabbat veyakol labo — sheyyabo vibasserenu:
